blocks.title: First words and direct questions
blocks.method: Poco a Poco begins with concrete nouns, pictures, short questions and model answers. Meaning is built through Spanish itself rather than long grammatical explanation.

blocks.title: Description and agreement
blocks.method: The course expands descriptions and repeatedly places related words together so gender, number and adjective agreement become visible through use.
outcomes: describe familiar people, animals and objects

blocks.title: Actions and everyday narration
blocks.method: More verbs and connected scenes allow the learner to move beyond naming and description into actions, sequence and simple narration.
outcomes: retell familiar material in simple Spanish

blocks.title: Longer reading and response
blocks.method: Readings become longer and questions demand more than one-word replies. Earlier forms continue to return so recognition becomes increasingly automatic.

blocks.title: Greater range and independence
blocks.method: Vocabulary and structures widen while the direct-method rhythm remains the same: observe, answer, repeat, read and reuse.
outcomes: understand familiar material at greater speed

blocks.title: Consolidation and onward use
blocks.method: The final block consolidates the book’s graded progression and prepares the learner to carry the method into modern listening, conversation and further reading.
outcomes: hold a conversation on familiar subjects
continue towards a balanced A2 and conversational B1 pathway
